sampling.note: one ISR per switching period; both loops at f_s

continuous_prototype.form: C(s) = K (1 + s/w_z)^2 / (s (1 + s/w_p)); Tustin pre-warped at f_c

voltage_loop.structure: 2P2Z (DF22) on the port-2 voltage error, output = current reference clamped to +-i_ref_limit

limitations: Cycle-averaged lossless plant: no switching waveforms, no losses, no magnetising current, no sensor/ADC model.
Protection acts with up to one period of latency on quasi-static analytic currents; hardware trips act within the period.
No firmware was built or executed; controller coefficients are host-side design values.
model_assumptions: Lossless SPS power stage: ideal switches, ideal transformer, no dead-time effect on power, stiff port-1 source (optional static series resistance).
Cycle-averaged: phase shift and port voltages held over one update interval; the series-inductor current is not a state (valid for bandwidths well below f_sw/10).
Magnetising current neglected; the lossless piecewise-linear series current is reported as a quasi-static estimate for protection studies only.
Port-2 capacitor update is the exact ZOH discretisation of C2 with a resistive and/or current-source load for piecewise-constant currents.
No sensor dynamics, ADC quantisation or noise; the one-period averaging of the measured current and the computation delay are modelled in the controller loop.

modulator.leg_to_leg: leg B/D outputs are the swapped leg A/C outputs (180 degrees); S4=S1, S3=S2, S8=S5, S7=S6 patterns
modulator.sign_convention: phi > 0: secondary lags primary, power flows from port 1 to port 2
modulator.time_origin: centre of primary positive half-cycle (S1, S4 on); register load at the period boundary (m - 1/2) T
